scythe_long.note: the repaired strips' whole straight darkin scythe (cut from work rh_skill2 3, hands left out): pommel left, blade right pointing up, joint = far grip on the shaft (shaft core rows 10-11). Use on the 'scythe' part: ['sprite', 'scythe_long'] then rot/flip/deg/at - matches the kept repaired frames' scythe size (the design's own scythe is drawn smaller).

hips.note: Leg pairs (legs_*): both legs in one sprite, joint = the hips' middle, which goes on the design's hips' middle (canvas 62, 85 = the torso joint). Use the pseudo-part 'hips': put 'hips' in the frame's 'order' where 'far_leg' was and leave out 'far_leg' and 'near_leg' (or 'hide' them), parts {'hips': [['sprite', 'legs_crouch', [62, 85]], ...more ops]}, and 'move': [0, dy]. Planted pairs (crouch, lunge, kneel): dy = the sprite's 'drop' so the hips come down with the body and the soles stand on the soles' row. Airborne pairs ('air': legs_tuck, legs_hang): lift the body, dy <= 'max_dy' (= 14 - 'low'; legs_tuck needs dy <= -1, legs_hang <= 0), or the renderer's cut below the soles' row (frame[FEET_ROW + 1:] = 0) takes the toes. 'low' = rows from the joint to the sprite's lowest pixel. Put 'hips' after 'scythe' instead when the legs must cover the shaft. Both legs wear the near leg's colours (F/K/I thigh, no darker far leg); legs_darkin.py --far design rewrites them with the idle's navy far leg. Drawn by work/ka/legs_darkin.py + legs_darkin_maps.py.
